heroIntro: Mind & Body Medicine with Isabel Florido
heroTitle: “Care for your body so that your Soul wants to dwell in it”
heroDescription:
The art of teaching conscious, intelligent movement.

Learn to live in harmony in body and mind, cultivating mindful awareness.
aboutIntroduction: Sharing knowledge and a curiosity for learning have shaped my entire journey. Today, that same calling informs a practice that brings together body, mind and movement.
aboutBiography: For almost twenty years, I taught at the Faculty of Translation and Interpreting at the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. I have studied, lived and worked in different countries. That experience, together with my interest in methodology, is at the heart of how I support others.
aboutNote:
Each person has their own rhythm.
Each moment, its own needs.
methodTitle: Mind and body. One shared practice.
methodDescription: Mind & Body Medicine is the name of my approach to holistic personal training. It brings body awareness, mental focus, coordination and memory exercises together in one practice.
methodSummary: Breathing, mobility, strength, flexibility and balance are explored alongside concentration, rhythm and movement control. The practice starts from where you are today and adapts to you.
sessionsDescription: A personal training approach that combines the tools from my training according to your needs. We start from where you are today, with postural observation and an individual assessment of your needs before designing your practice.
sessionLanguagesDescription: Sessions in Spanish, English and French.
sessionApproachTitle: Adapted to where you are today
sessionApproachDescription: Breathing, mobility, strength, balance and awareness, according to your needs.
contactDescription: The first step is to get to know each other and understand what you need to build your practice.

faqs.question: What do the sessions focus on?
faqs.answer: The approach brings together physical skills and attention: breathing, mobility, strength, flexibility, balance, coordination, memory and concentration. Exercises are selected according to each person’s needs.

faqs.question: Which languages are available?
faqs.answer: Sessions are available in Spanish, English and French, both in person and online.

faqs.question: How do we decide where to begin?
faqs.answer: The method starts with initial postural observation and an individual assessment of your needs. This information is used to design your personal training practice.

faqs.question: How can I ask about availability and arrangements?
faqs.answer: You can contact Isabel by email or phone to ask about availability, the location of in-person sessions, duration and prices.

pillars.title: Coordination and memory
pillars.text: Bring attention and movement together through balance, rhythm and motor control.
